items.prompt: Circle your opinion: Cats are better pets than dogs. / Dogs are better pets than cats. Then write a sentence that states that opinion.
items.answer: Sample: I think dogs are better pets than cats.

steps: Choose one option and write it as 'I think ___.'

items.prompt: Write one reason that supports this opinion: 'I think school should start later in the morning.' Use the word 'because.'
items.answer: Sample: School should start later because students need more sleep to do their best work.

steps: Finish the sentence: 'School should start later because ___.'

items.prompt: Which is a better closing sentence for an opinion piece about chocolate ice cream? A) Ice cream is cold. B) That is why chocolate is the best flavor of ice cream! Explain your choice.
items.answer: B is better because it restates the opinion and wraps up the piece.

steps: A closing sentence should bring the piece to an end by restating the main opinion. Option B does this; Option A just states a fact.

items.prompt: Read: 'I think reading is better than watching TV.' Write one reason to support this opinion.
items.answer: Sample: Reading is great because it helps your brain grow and teaches you new things.

steps: Think about why reading is good. Write a 'because' sentence.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'Carrots are a good snack.' Is this an opinion or a fact? How could you rewrite it to make it clearly an opinion?
items.answer: It could be either. Rewrite as an opinion: 'I think carrots are the best snack you can eat.'

steps: Add 'I think' or 'I believe' to make it clearly an opinion.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank with a linking word (because, and, also): 'I think homework should be shorter. Shorter homework is better ___ students would have time to play outside.'

steps: 'Because' connects the opinion to the reason.

items.prompt: Write a topic sentence for an opinion piece about whether students should wear school uniforms.
items.answer: Sample: I think students should wear school uniforms every day.

steps: A topic sentence for an opinion piece states what you think. Start with 'I think' or 'I believe.'

items.prompt:
Match the part of an opinion piece to its job:
1. Topic sentence  2. Reason  3. Closing sentence
A) Wraps up the piece  B) States what the writer thinks  C) Explains why the writer thinks that

steps: Topic sentence = states the opinion. Reason = explains why. Closing sentence = wraps up.

items.prompt: Write a closing sentence for this opinion piece: 'I think the school cafeteria should serve pizza every Friday. Pizza is delicious because it has cheese and many toppings that kids love.'
items.answer: Sample: That is why I believe pizza Friday would make every student happy.

steps: A closing sentence restates the main opinion. It often starts with 'That is why' or 'For these reasons.'

items.prompt: Is this a reason or an opinion? 'I think math is the best subject.' Write a reason that could follow it.
items.answer: It is an opinion. Sample reason: Math is the best because it helps you solve problems in real life.

steps: 'I think' shows it is an opinion. A reason explains why by using 'because.'

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece of 2-3 sentences about your favorite animal. Include a topic sentence and one reason.
items.answer: Sample: I think elephants are the most amazing animals. Elephants are wonderful because they are smart, they help each other, and they never forget their friends.

steps: Topic sentence: state your favorite animal and that it is the best. Reason: explain why using 'because.'

items.prompt: A student wants to argue that PE class is important. Write a topic sentence for this opinion.
items.answer: Sample: I believe PE class is one of the most important parts of the school day.

steps: Start with 'I believe' or 'I think' and name the topic and the opinion.

items.prompt: Which sentence is the BEST reason for the opinion 'I think libraries are the best places to visit'? A) Libraries have books. B) Libraries are wonderful because you can find books on any topic you love and read as long as you want.
items.answer: B is the better reason because it uses 'because' and gives specific details.

steps: A good reason is specific and uses a linking word. Option B does both.

items.prompt:
Put these three sentences in the correct order for an opinion piece:
A) That is why I think soccer is a great sport for kids.
B) I think soccer is one of the best sports to play.
C) Soccer is great because it helps you stay active and teaches you to work as a team.

steps: Order: Topic sentence (B) → Reason (C) → Closing sentence (A).

items.prompt: Write a complete 3-sentence opinion piece about whether it is better to have one close friend or many friends. Include a topic sentence, one reason, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I think it is better to have one very close friend. Having one close friend is great because you can trust that person with your secrets and always count on them. That is why I believe one true friend is worth more than many.

steps: Sentence 1: topic sentence with 'I think.' Sentence 2: reason with 'because.' Sentence 3: closing with 'That is why.'
